Hentai Girls : Sexy Maid Party is a sliding puzzle game, providing a relaxing but comfortably challenging experience if desired. There are 20 puzzles of 5 different maid girls to unlock as you progress through the puzzles. Completing a puzzle unlocks the ability to view the animations for sex with the girl in the gallery!

- The gallery features animations from the puzzles you completed. View all the sexy maids, and their hot scenes with you, in the gallery!

- Listen to some cheerful music as you complete each puzzle

- Earn achievements by completing the puzzles.

- Easy Mode
